ICE and tZERO have entered into agreements to develop infrastructure for ICE’s planned NYSE-affiliated tokenized securities platform. tZERO will help design digital transfer-agent and broker-dealer systems intended to support on-chain settlement, while ICE will invest in tZERO’s latest financing round and license its blockchain patent portfolio.
